warning_source: Egyptian/Sinwar warning via Shin Bet-Egyptian channel
recipient: Israeli intelligence community and political echelon; Netanyahu route separately reported
progress: Israel Hayom 25 Mar 2026 says official early Military Intelligence inquiry documents record a mid-September Sinwar message passed through a Shin Bet channel with senior Egyptian figures: by end-September Hamas would present something causing an 'earthquake' and release all prisoners. It says the message was seen in the intelligence community and political echelon and discussed. Notion WARN-8 was upgraded with this documentary-recovery evidence.
gaps: Underlying inquiry documents remain unpublished. Do not yet merge this mid-September account with the early-September Army Radio Egyptian warning, the Sep. 15 Palestinian/Emirati intermediary route, WARN-15, or the alleged direct Kamel-Netanyahu call; provenance remains unresolved.

progress: September 2026 reporting remains materially corroborated by a Times of Israel Emirati source familiar with the conversation, who said the warning came in a leaders' phone call; the UAE Foreign Ministry did not confirm or deny the specific call but said relevant intelligence is shared when necessary. Current Notion entry already contains this evidence.
gaps: PMO categorically denies the warning. No public transcript or official UAE confirmation of the specific call. Continue dedupe/provenance work against the Sep. 15 Sinwar/intermediary warning chain.

recipient: Israeli Foreign Ministry and National Security Council
progress: Israel Hayom 29 Dec 2025 reports a senior Egyptian source saying an Egyptian delegation warned Foreign Ministry counterparts about two weeks before Oct. 7 that Gaza was 'explosive' and could escalate; several Israeli Foreign Ministry sources reportedly corroborated receipt of Egyptian messages that the Palestinian/Gaza situation was very sensitive and could explode. The same investigation cites two Israeli political sources saying a focused 'something big' warning reached the NSC.
gaps: Foreign Ministry formally denied the described meeting/information; NSC said it had no information about a general Foreign Ministry warning and no concrete Oct. 7/war warning. Keep the general Foreign Ministry route and focused NSC route analytically separable until documents/named witnesses resolve them.

progress: Israel Hayom documented/reported a plane linked to Egyptian intelligence landing briefly at Ben Gurion on Sep. 26 and cited officials familiar with special-operations protocols who believed an urgent meeting may have occurred aboard it.
gaps: This is inference, not proof of a warning event or recipient. NSC said it was unaware of the plane. Do not promote without flight/meeting records or named participants.

progress: Rechecked Michael McCaul's post-classified-briefing statement that Egypt warned 'the Israelis' three days before the attack and that a warning was given, while he explicitly said the recipient level was unclear. Earlier AP reporting independently quotes an Egyptian intelligence official saying repeated warnings of 'something big' were conveyed.
gaps: Need primary US briefing record or Egyptian/Israeli documentation identifying recipient and exact content. Preserve Egyptian-linked and PMO denials; do not infer Netanyahu receipt.

progress: Egyptian Presidency primary readout records Sissi directly telling newly installed Netanyahu to avoid measures that would lead to tension and complicate the regional situation, while emphasizing maintenance of Israeli-Palestinian calm; AP contemporaneously corroborated.
gaps: Direct receipt is clear, but warning is very general and not Hamas/Gaza-specific. Hold pending consistent threshold decision on whether generic diplomatic de-escalation warnings are materially relevant enough to Oct. 7 preparedness for publication.

progress: Royal Court readout, contemporaneous AP/ToI reporting and Netanyahu's office confirm the Amman meeting. Abdullah stressed preserving the Al-Aqsa status quo, maintaining calm and ending violence; reporting also describes concern about possible Jerusalem/West Bank violence around overlapping Ramadan/Passover.
gaps: Direct receipt is clear but the event is a broad escalation-prevention warning, not a Hamas/Gaza attack warning. Hold pending scope-threshold consistency review.

warning_source: Diplomats from several unnamed Arab states
recipient: Jerusalem / Israeli government; named recipient unresolved
progress: Contemporaneous reporting says several Arab diplomats contacted Jerusalem before Ben Gvir's Temple Mount visit, warning it could deteriorate security in Jerusalem, the West Bank and the wider region.
gaps: States and specific Israeli recipients are unnamed; warning remains too diffuse for acceptance.

warning_source: US Deputy Secretary of State Wendy Sherman / US State Department
recipient: Israeli Ambassador Mike Herzog / Israeli government channel
progress: Contemporaneous N12/US readout says Sherman summoned Herzog and stressed avoiding acts or statements that could further inflame tensions ahead of Ramadan, Passover and Easter; France/Germany issued similar public escalation warnings about contemporaneous Israeli measures.
gaps: Recipient is a senior state diplomat but warning is broad and policy-focused; establish whether it crossed the materiality threshold and whether it was formally transmitted to relevant security/government decision-makers.

status: Negative finding / not qualifying on current evidence
recipient: US government recipients; no Israeli recipient established
progress: Reviewed reporting on Sep. 28 and Oct. 5 US intelligence products warning of possible Hamas/Israel violence or attack risk. Public reporting describes circulation inside the US government and says the reports did not reach top US policymakers.
gaps: No evidence found that these reports were delivered to Israeli decision-makers. Do not count as a warning to Israel unless transmission evidence surfaces.
